import json, re, shutil, platform
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'docs/evidence/pre_h03'
active=[p for p in root.rglob('*.md') if not {'.git','.godot','history','__pycache__'}.intersection(p.relative_to(root).parts)]
patterns=[r'^- Proyecto:.*estética industrial \+ PS1',r'^- PC/Windows.*dirección visual retro industrial \+ cyberpunk PS1',r'^Sala industrial de referencia PS1',r'^Aplicar ART_BIBLE.*; post FX PS1',r'^- Retro industrial \+ cyberpunk PS1']
failures=[]
matches=[]
for p in active:
    for n,line in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(),1):
        if any(re.search(pattern,line,re.I) for pattern in patterns):
            failures.append({'file':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'line':n,'text':line})
        if re.search(r'PS1|PSX|nearest|wobble|dither',line,re.I):
            matches.append({'file':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'line':n,'text':line})
report={'active_documents':len(active),'obsolete_normative_patterns':patterns,'failures':failures,'artistic_references_for_semantic_review':matches,'limit':'Comprueba patrones conocidos, no certifica coherencia semántica ni calidad visual.'}
(out/'style_scan_report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('ACTIVE_MARKDOWN',len(active),'OBSOLETE_NORMATIVE_MATCHES',len(failures),'ARTISTIC_REFERENCES',len(matches))
print('OS',platform.platform(),'GODOT_PATH',shutil.which('godot'),'GODOT4_PATH',shutil.which('godot4'))
print('Godot fuera de PATH: consultar godot_version.json')
raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)
